title: HookEvo: A Framework for Coordinated Plugin Evolution on Hook-Enabled Agent Runtimes
abstract: arXiv:2611.27294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Repairing failures in tool-using agents can require coordinated changes to how the harness interprets tool receipts, assembles context, and checks actions. We introduce HookEvo, a framework that uses an existing agent runtime's lifecycle hooks to evolve task-specific harnesses. We instantiate HookEvo on DeepSeek Harness. In each round, a separate improver diagnoses failures from execution traces and proposes a candidate. HookEvo evaluates the candidate against the current harness on matched tasks and carries the retained version into the next round. A single candidate can jointly edit executable plugin handlers and the state they share within a task, allowing a tool receipt to inform context and control a later action. Using a frozen Qwen3-4B executor, the selected harnesses lead the reported Qwen3-4B comparisons, achieving 95.41% on ALFWorld, 70.56% on DBBench, 48.17% on WebShop, and 41.67% on OSBench. translated_title: HookEvo：一种基于钩子启用的智能体运行时的协同插件进化框架
translated_abstract: 修复使用工具的智能体中的故障，可能需要对运行框架如何解释工具回执、组装上下文以及检查动作等方面进行协同修改。我们提出了HookEvo，这是一个利用现有智能体运行时生命周期钩子来进化特定任务运行框架的框架。我们在DeepSeek Harness上实例化了HookEvo。在每一轮中，一个独立的改进器从执行轨迹中诊断故障并提出候选方案。HookEvo在匹配的任务上将候选方案与当前运行框架进行比较评估，并将保留的版本带入下一轮。单个候选方案可以联合编辑可执行的插件处理器以及它们在任务中共享的状态，使工具回执能够为上下文提供信息并控制后续动作。使用冻结的Qwen3-4B执行器，所选的运行框架在已报告的Qwen3-4B对比中处于领先地位，在ALFWorld上达到95.41%，在DBBench上达到70.56%，在WebShop上达到48.17%，在OSBench上达到41.67%。在三个改进器和三个……
tldr: 提出了HookEvo框架，利用智能体运行时的生命周期钩子，在每轮迭代中协同进化可执行插件处理器与共享状态，无需改动冻结的执行器即可让Qwen3-4B在ALFWorld、DBBench等多个基准上取得领先成绩。
en_tdlr: HookEvo is a framework that leverages an agent runtime's lifecycle hooks to co-evolve executable plugin handlers and their shared state across iterative rounds, enabling a frozen Qwen3-4B executor to achieve leading results on benchmarks such as ALFWorld, DBBench, WebShop, and OSBench.
